name: Yoin
source:
The Antenna speaks to you. me. Me?

It calls by name. I call her something more... recognizable?

Fragments scraped from a surface.

I go out.

[From [url=https://nouzivr.itch.io/yoin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“天线”正在对你说话。对我说。是我吗？

它直呼其名。我则用某个更……容易辨认的称呼来叫她？

从表层刮落下来的碎片。

我出门了。

[摘自[url=https://nouzivr.itch.io/yoin]itch.io[/url]]
